设计意图： Measures persistence of volume intensity using continuous volume ratio (volume/EMA). Stocks with sustained high relative volume exhibit smoother price behavior and lower noise, aligning with temporal consistency focus. Uses vol_ratio from classify_volume_regime instead of binary flag to capture continuous information.

已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)), 60)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))
  3. 3. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
使用字段：
列含义说明
Volume成交量当日成交量（股数），反映参与度

  1. 计算 persistence：vol_ratio.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=30).mean()
